MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick feels useful because it could add streaming to my Samsung 720p TV, and HD fits that screen's capabilities.",
    "Connecting a recommendation to equipment I already own makes sense to me; I often buy accessories that add a practical function to an existing device."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The WYZE cameras and Blink doorbell serve home monitoring, while my tripods, film, and lens cap support taking photographs. Sharing the word camera does not make them useful for the same purpose.",
    "The 4K streaming sticks offer display capabilities my current TV cannot use, so I would choose the HD option instead.",
    "The Echo devices and smart plug assume I want voice control or home automation, but I have no current need for those functions. My car accessories support mounting and powering a GPS, not adding Alexa."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Amazon and Alexa devices, although my purchases do not establish that interest.",
    "Broad connections such as cameras, car electronics, and power accessories seem to matter too much compared with what I actually use each item to accomplish."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated memory-card purchases, card cases, and card reader show an ongoing need to store, organize, and transfer files.",
    "My purchases often depend on specific compatibility: a lens-cap size, a charging connector, a tablet mount, or a memory-card format. Those details matter more to me than simply being another electronic device.",
    "I frequently buy supporting accessories for equipment I already have. That does not mean I currently want to start a home-monitoring or voice-assistant setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The HD streaming stick connects well to my existing TV, but most of the list mistakes my practical accessory purchases for interest in smart-home devices."
}
